member.summary: Builds a report with a session summary, the hottest scopes and a call tree per thread.
member.param: Names and categories for ids; the metadata of the trace when.
How many scopes to list, ordered by inclusive time.
How many levels of the call tree to print.
When set, only scopes of this category are listed.
Hides scopes that take less than this share of the session, in percent.
Adds p25, p50, p75, p95 and p99 columns to the hotspot table. A scope with more completions than the sample limit has its percentiles prefixed with ~ and no p25 or p75.
The measured cost of a scope. When set, a note column marks scopes whose median is short enough for that cost to exceed 5% of it.

member.name: M:EmberTrace.TraceText.WriteScopeTable(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable{EmberTrace.Analysis.Compare.TraceRun},System.IO.TextWriter,EmberTrace.Metadata.ITraceMetadataProvider)
member.summary: Writes one CSV row per run and scope, the input for plotting and external statistics.
member.param: The runs to write, in order.
The writer that receives the CSV.
Names for ids; the metadata of each run when, else the id.
member.remarks: Columns: run,arm,round,id,name,count,total_ms,mean_ms,min_ms,p25_ms,p50_ms,p75_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,max_ms,exact,bimodal,overflow,dropped. Numbers use the invariant culture, fields are quoted as in RFC 4180 and lines end with CRLF. The p25_ms, p75_ms and bimodal cells are empty for a scope that exceeded the sample limit.
